title: Sultanate society: more on religion, women, Sufis

boxes.title: Society & ulema: added detail
items: Hindu society: little change; ==Brahmins at top== of caste order
Muslims: **ashraf-ajlaf** stratification despite Quranic equality; ajlaf by occupation
Ulema wanted a say in state policy; relied on by Firoz
Alauddin told ==**Qazi Mughisuddin**== he decreed what was good for the state
**Iltutmish**: tolerant, gave non-Muslims posts
MBT visited the ==**Ajmer** shrine==

boxes.title: Firoz, Sikandar & temples
items: Firoz: respected **Caliph of Egypt**; ==prohibited public idol worship==; penalised Hindus + **Shias**
Sikandar Lodi broke **Jwalamukhi** images at Nagarkot; enforced jizya
Temple destruction motives: ==political== (rival royal legitimacy) + ==economic== (temple wealth)
Jizya = protection tax in place of military service; collected unevenly

cards.title: Women
lines: Purdah brought by **Arabs, Turks**; child marriage
Razia resisted due to gender norms

boxes.title: Conversion & Bhakti
items: Conversion ==**multi-causal**==, gradual; incl. spiritual conviction
Patronage: tax relief, office; caste-like strata survived among converts
Sufis via **pirs**, dargahs + **agrarian expansion**
Bhakti roots: **Alvars, Nayanars**; Islam shaped egalitarianism of **Kabir, Nanak, Ravidas**
Deccan: Hindu **Nayakas** served Sultans; Sultans patronised temples

boxes.title: AP & current: more
items: Islam in Andhra with ==**Malik Kafur** (**1310**)== and MBT
Gesu Daraz (**Bandanawaz**): *Mirqat-ul-Ashyaq*; under Firoz Shah Bahmani
Golconda: **Afaqis** = foreign Muslims; Brahmins got agraharas + **Mustajir** rights
**Tana Shah**: villages to ==**Bhadrachalam**== temple
"**Paro**" bride-slavery: Haryana, Rajasthan, UP (**23 Jan 2026**)
